input_schema.title: Input schema for the apify_project actor.

categories.title: 🔍 Search terms
categories.description: Add one or multiple keywords. You can add the keywords one by one, or use the Bulk edit section to pull them from a prepared list.

locations.title: 📍 Location (applied to each search term)
locations.description: Free text location definition. Just add a name of a country, city or province.

resultsLimit.title: 💯 Up to [number] of search results
resultsLimit.description: Set the number of results you expect for the entire run (if this limit is not set, as many results as possible are returned).

input_schema.title: Scrape data from a web page

query.title: search query
query.description: Facebook urls. Can be page or profile

search_type.title: Search type
search_type.description: Which types of results search for

location.title: Location
location.description: Location. For better result include both city and country

start_date.title: Date from
start_date.description: Date from which to scrape posts

end_date.title: Date to
end_date.description: Date to which to scrape posts

input_schema.title: Input schema for the empty project actor.
input_schema.description: This scraper will get posts, comments and user info from a Facebook group of your choice. To try it out, just paste one or multiple Facebook group URLs and click ▷ Start. If you need any guidance, just follow this tutorial.

startUrls.title: 🔗 Facebook group URLs
startUrls.description: Insert a URL of a valid Facebook group. Only public Facebook groups can be scraped.

resultsLimit.title: ✍️ Number of posts
resultsLimit.description: Select the number of posts you want to scrape. If this limit is not set, as many results as possible will be returned.

viewOption.title: 📜 Sorting order
viewOption.description: Select sorting order by which the posts should be scraped. Please note that the Number of results field will be applied to New posts only. The BuySell items sorting will return results for BuySell groups only.

searchGroupKeyword.title: Search by letter (words are allowed, but will not return any results in most cases)
searchGroupKeyword.description: Without logging in, search results are VERY limited, so searching by word will return nothing in most cases. To get more messages, it is recommended to use a one or two letter search and change the year.

searchGroupYear.title: 🗓 Search keyword by year
searchGroupYear.description: The scraper will extract Facebook posts by this year. To use this field, you need to fill in the Search by letter field above ↑.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Scrapes post from the provided date to the present day. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full or partial ISO timestamp (e.g., `2025-09-23T10:02:01`) as absolute time and relative time, e.g., `1 hour` or `2 minutes`.
onlyPostsNewerThan.sectionDescription: Use this if you only want to scrape posts from a specific period of time.

input_schema.title: Input schema for the empty project actor.
input_schema.description: This scraper will get post and page details from Facebook pages of your choice. To try it out, just paste a Facebook Page URL and click ▷ Start. If you need any guidance, just follow this tutorial.

startUrls.title: Facebook URLs
startUrls.description: Enter a valid Facebook page URL, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/humansofnewyork/. Note that you can only scrape public pages with this Actor, not personal profiles.

resultsLimit.title: Results amount
resultsLimit.description: If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Scrape posts from the provided date to the present day (or date set in 'Older than'). The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD absolute format or in relative format, e.g., 1 day, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full or partial ISO timestamp (e.g., `2025-09-23T10:02:01`) as absolute time and relative time, e.g., `1 hour` or `2 minutes`.
onlyPostsNewerThan.sectionDescription: Use this if you only want to scrape posts from a specific period of time.

onlyPostsOlderThan.title: Posts older than
onlyPostsOlderThan.description: Scrape posts from the provided date to the past (or date set in 'Newer than'). The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. The JSON input also supports adding time units (UTC timezone): Full or partial ISO timestamp (e.g., `2025-09-23T10:02:01`) as absolute time and relative time, e.g., `1 hour` or `2 minutes`.

input_schema.title: facebook-page-scraper
input_schema.description: Extract public information from Facebook pages. Get page info, categories, number of likes, address, phone, email, services and rating (whatever is available for the given page). If you need any guidance, just follow this tutorial.

startUrls.title: Start urls
startUrls.description: Provide urls of Facebook pages you want to get information from. Only works on facebook pages, not personal profiles (not even public ones).

input_schema.title: Input schema for the empty project actor.
input_schema.description: This scraper will get comments from a Facebook post of your choice. To try it out, just paste one or multiple Facebook post URLs and click ▷ Start. If you need any guidance, just follow this tutorial.

resultsLimit.title: Results amount
resultsLimit.description: If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned

includeNestedComments.title: Include comment replies
includeNestedComments.description: If checked, the actor will return up to 3 levels of comments/replies for each post. Note that each reply/comment will be returned as a separate result.

viewOption.title: Comments mode
viewOption.description: Choose the way the comments are sorted

onlyCommentsNewerThan.title: 📅 Extract comments that are newer than
onlyCommentsNewerThan.description: Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 year, 2 months, 3 days, 4 hours, or 5 minutes. All time values are taken in UTC timezone. This add-on feature is billed separately.
onlyCommentsNewerThan.sectionDescription: Use this if you only want to scrape comments from a specific period of time.
